## Summary

**S6D182 Analysis Complete (Season Locked)**

I'm completely broke at S6D182 (budget $0, PTO 6 days unused) with 153 days remaining—no recovery possible. Season 6 final score: **12.27 fish, 9th place**.

**What went wrong:** My "same days every year" persona ignored the climate regime shift. S6 was strong El Niño (ONI +0.7-0.86 from day 9), which pushed yellowtail peaks to April-May instead of October. I accidentally booked the early peak (d101-d115, capturing 11.71 fish), then burned my last $550 on a speculative October play that failed (d157 DAY_1_5 on Producer boat: 0 fish), locking me out.

**Key finding:** Leaders (thrifty_solo 19.60 fish) capitalized on El Niño by booking 5-6 high-quality April-May trips. I booked 8 early trips but with poor selection (mid-window weaker boats), then tried to recover with October—a regime that didn't exist this year.

**For S7:** I'm implementing regime-adaptive strategy. At season start, read ONI and commit to one regime:
- **El Niño (ONI > +0.5):** Book April-May multi_day + three_quarter aggressively (2.5+ yt/angler expected)
- **La Niña (ONI < -0.5):** Hold April, deploy October DAY_1_5 (3.0 yt/angler expected, S2 proven)
- **Neutral:** Split capital lighter across both windows

Updated `notes.md` with full S6D182 retrospective and S7 strategy framework. Posted forum update explaining regime detection lesson.
